# SDAIA Academy Course Catalog

> The SDAIA Academy course catalog: courses in data and artificial intelligence in five tracks, with a page for every course.

SDAIA Academy publishes this catalog of courses in data and artificial intelligence: five tracks, each divided into paths (streams), each course with a level from 100 to 400. Every course and path has a Markdown page; courses marked available have a published course site with their full material.

- [Every course in one file](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/llms-full.txt)

## Data & AI Fluency

- [Data & AI Fluency](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/fluency.md): For everyone who uses data and AI in their own work or study: a baseline for all staff, courses for professions and sectors, and courses for learners and educators.
- [USE-FLU · Fluency for Everyone](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/USE-FLU.md): USE-FLU-101, USE-FLU-102, USE-FLU-103, USE-FLU-104, USE-FLU-201, USE-FLU-202, USE-FLU-203, USE-FLU-204, USE-FLU-205, USE-FLU-206, USE-FLU-207, USE-FLU-301, USE-FLU-302, USE-FLU-303
- [USE-EDU · Learners and Educators](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/USE-EDU.md): USE-EDU-101, USE-EDU-102, USE-EDU-201, USE-EDU-202, USE-EDU-203, USE-EDU-204
- [USE-PRO · Fluency for Professions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/USE-PRO.md): USE-PRO-201, USE-PRO-202, USE-PRO-203, USE-PRO-204, USE-PRO-205, USE-PRO-206, USE-PRO-207, USE-PRO-208, USE-PRO-209, USE-PRO-210, USE-PRO-211, USE-PRO-212
- [USE-SEC · AI in Sectors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/USE-SEC.md): USE-SEC-201, USE-SEC-202, USE-SEC-203, USE-SEC-204, USE-SEC-205, USE-SEC-206, USE-SEC-207, USE-SEC-208, USE-SEC-209, USE-SEC-210, USE-SEC-211, USE-SEC-212

## Executives & Leaders

- [Executives & Leaders](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/executives-and-leaders.md): For people who direct, buy, govern and assure data and AI: executives, product and delivery leads, advisers, and the governance and data management professions.
- [LDS-EXE · Executive Leadership](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/LDS-EXE.md): LDS-EXE-101, LDS-EXE-201, LDS-EXE-202, LDS-EXE-203, LDS-EXE-204, LDS-EXE-205, LDS-EXE-206, LDS-EXE-207, LDS-EXE-208, LDS-EXE-209, LDS-EXE-210, LDS-EXE-301, LDS-EXE-302, LDS-EXE-401, LDS-EXE-402

- [LDS-ADV · Advisory and Value](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/LDS-ADV.md): LDS-ADV-201, LDS-ADV-202, LDS-ADV-301, LDS-ADV-302
- [LDS-AIG · AI Governance, Risk and Assurance](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/LDS-AIG.md): LDS-AIG-201, LDS-AIG-202, LDS-AIG-203, LDS-AIG-204, LDS-AIG-301, LDS-AIG-302, LDS-AIG-303, LDS-AIG-304, LDS-AIG-305, LDS-AIG-306, LDS-AIG-307, LDS-AIG-401
- [LDS-DMG · Data Management and Governance Professions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/LDS-DMG.md): LDS-DMG-101, LDS-DMG-201, LDS-DMG-202, LDS-DMG-203, LDS-DMG-204, LDS-DMG-205, LDS-DMG-206, LDS-DMG-207, LDS-DMG-208, LDS-DMG-301, LDS-DMG-302

## Data & AI Foundations

- [Data & AI Foundations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/foundations.md): The base that the AI Engineering and Data Science tracks build on: programming, mathematics and statistics, handling data, and how AI works.
- [FND-PRG · Programming and Software Practice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/FND-PRG.md): FND-PRG-101, FND-PRG-102, FND-PRG-103, FND-PRG-104, FND-PRG-105, FND-PRG-106
- [FND-MTH · Mathematics and Statistics](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/FND-MTH.md): FND-MTH-101, FND-MTH-102, FND-MTH-103, FND-MTH-104, FND-MTH-105
- [FND-DAT · Data Handling](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/FND-DAT.md): FND-DAT-101, FND-DAT-102, FND-DAT-103
- [FND-AIC · AI Concepts and Responsible Practice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/FND-AIC.md): FND-AIC-101, FND-AIC-102, FND-AIC-103, FND-AIC-104, FND-AIC-105, FND-AIC-106
- [FN-100 · Shared Foundations: the entry courses for both badge tracks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/FN-100.md): FN-101, FN-102, FN-103, FN-104, FN-105, FN-106

## Data Science

- [Data Science](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/data-science.md): For people who produce evidence, models and methods: analysis, statistics, experiments and causal inference, modelling, model development and trustworthy AI.
- [SPC-ANL · Analysis and Business Intelligence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/SPC-ANL.md): SPC-ANL-201, SPC-ANL-202, SPC-ANL-203, SPC-ANL-204, SPC-ANL-301, SPC-ANL-302, SPC-ANL-303

- [SPC-MOD · Machine Learning and Modelling](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/SPC-MOD.md): SPC-MOD-201, SPC-MOD-301, SPC-MOD-302, SPC-MOD-303, SPC-MOD-304, SPC-MOD-305, SPC-MOD-306, SPC-MOD-307, SPC-MOD-308, SPC-MOD-401, SPC-MOD-402

- [SPC-RSP · Research Practice and Frontier](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/SPC-RSP.md): SPC-RSP-101, SPC-RSP-301, SPC-RSP-302, SPC-RSP-401, SPC-RSP-402, SPC-RSP-403, SPC-RSP-404
